column1: # p401 — the Moodle PLUGIN grant channel, over the WHOLE shelf family.
# Question: can the LICENSE-path ladder see this family's grants?  Answer: half of them, no.
# channel_L = LICENSE / LICENSE.md / LICENSE.txt / COPYING  (what prior passes probed)
# channel_P = a GNU GPL notice in the PHP file header       (this family's real convention)
# Family identified by TEXT TITLE, never by a name occurring anywhere: GPL-3.0 section 13
#   is titled 'Use with the GNU Affero General Public License', so a name-anywhere match
#   grades every GPL-3.0 payload AGPL (p401-B; it did, 7 times, in this pass's first run).
# Verdicts: LADDER_BLIND BOTH_AGREE CHANNEL_CONFLICT NO_GRANT_EITHER_CHANNEL PHANTOM EXISTS_EMPTY_TREE
# All probes 2026-10-23 via raw.githubusercontent.com; existence via authenticated search (fork:true).
